question: Do eight connectivity-selected upstream neurons drive DNg02 firing in fixed full-v783 LIF model, and does response require their outgoing connections?
hypothesis: A positive upstream drive should collapse when stimulated inputs' outgoing synapses are disconnected if DNg02 response is connectivity-mediated.
candidate_tests: A: upstream stimulation versus sham; 8 graph-selected inputs at150Hz for200ms, seeds42/43/44; measure mean DNg02 Hz across all25 readouts and paired differences.
B: outgoing-connectivity necessity control; identical input with stimulated inputs' outgoing synapses disconnected; measure fractional reduction vs driven output.

conditions.upstream_drive: 8 graph-selected upstream inputs at150Hz for200ms, seeds42/43/44.
conditions.outgoing_disconnection: Identical input with stimulated inputs' outgoing synapses disconnected, seeds42/43/44.
conditions.sham: A background only; not this B receipt.
conditions.direct_calibration: separate calibration/feasibility context; not used as evidence for this B outgoing-dependency result.
conditions.manual_feasibility: separate manual feasibility context; not used as native B evidence.

actual_result: B completed. Upstream-drive DNg02 population mean rates were [17.2,18.8,18.4] Hz, mean 18.133333333333333. Outgoing-disconnected rates were [0,0,0] Hz, mean 0. Paired fractional reductions were [1,1,1]. supports_outgoing_dependency true.

result.decision_rule_applied: effect-plus-necessity branch: prior A showed nonzero driven response vs sham; latest B shows complete collapse to 0Hz after disconnecting stimulated inputs' outgoing synapses, so proceed to matched input and sensory validation rather than claiming biological flight or repeating for instability.

updated_decision: Model output depends on source axonal weights; next validate upstream identities and test a matched non-target input before any biological flight claim
decision_reason: The actual B receipt shows a 100% fractional reduction across all three seeds when outgoing synapses are disconnected, distinguishing numerical propagation through source axonal weights from sham, direct calibration, body physics, or manual feasibility contexts.
limitations: literature only tethered already-established flight wing amplitude
graph upstream inputs not natural sensory proof
